name: Popover / AI Citation
description: AI Citation product scenario for the Popover component.

controls.name: content
controls.description: Content of the floating surface; empty content renders the trigger alone. Tooltip content must stay noninteractive.

controls.name: children
controls.description: One trigger element forwarding props/ref, or text rendered as a Button.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Controlled visibility; updates from the parent never call onOpenChange.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Visibility on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

controls.name: side
controls.description: Preferred side; may flip when the opposite side has more room.

controls.name: align
controls.description: Logical alignment on the cross axis, following dir or the trigger's direction.

controls.name: sideOffset
controls.description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and the content membrane; negative values overlap them. Default 2.

controls.name: attachmentSelector
controls.description: Nearest ancestor used for left/right attachment; --uf-dropdown-panel-gap measures the painted surface gap. Vertical alignment still follows the trigger.

controls.name: alignToOption
controls.description: Aligns a measured visible row opposite the trigger on left/right surfaces; pass the row's selector.

controls.name: dir
controls.description: Content direction; omitted inherits the trigger's, auto follows the content.
